answer: Helium-style proof-of-coverage ties each agent to a real radio in a real place. Each agent registers one LoRa hotspot at a mapped spot. Every epoch a random challenger orders a hotspot to send a coded pulse, and neighbors 300 m to 5 km away sign what they heard plus signal strength. The ledger checks that the physics fits the map and pays only witnessed agents. Even at the zenith of a fraud wave, 1,000 fakes need 1,000 hotspots at ~$400 on separate rooftops: ~$400,000 and months of setup. A farm with one antenna is a single lantern posing as a lit street, and one glance gives it away.
